verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, which is what the story asks for. The evidence is only a single existence check, though, with no detail on capabilities or how it applies to Connect. missing for 10: documented Connect-specific CLI workflows (e.g., connected-account operations, webhook forwarding for Connect events), detail on CLI features for AI or agentic use, independent or hands-on corroboration.
